title: Download an invoice
goal: Download a paid invoice as a PDF
benefit: Keep a copy for expense records
details: Open Billing and select Download on a paid invoice. The saved PDF includes the invoice number shown in the list. The sample files illustrate the expected result with fictional data.

acceptance.text: Selecting Download on a paid invoice returns a PDF containing that invoice number.

proof.observation: The synthetic log shows a PDF response for invoice EXAMPLE-001.
